Aisha: Quick heads-up — Helios Analytics just went live with our Dedicated + GCP Marketplace integration. Signed a 3-year reserved capacity deal this morning :tada: and their pilot is already running at 99th p50 SLA.
Ben: Amazing news — congrats team! Any logos/quote we can use for GTM?
Aisha: Yes, CS got a short quote. Helios: "Redwood made inference predictable at scale — our latency dropped 40% and costs are down 30%." I asked legal for quick approval to publish.
Carlos: Nice. Who's owning the co-sell assets/marketplace listing updates?
Priya: I can own the case study + marketplace tile update. Will sync with CS. Tentative plan: one-pager, 2-min explainer vid, and a short technical appendix.
Elena: /cc @ops-bot for onboarding checklist — we still need their VPC peering completed and key rotation scheduled.
ops-bot: Reminder: Helios (customer-id: hls-9082) - pending items: 1) VPC peering (config submitted), 2) KMS integration (awaiting key policy), 3) RBAC review. ETA 48h.
Ben: Timeline for press/announce?
Priya: If legal approves the quote by EOD tomorrow, we can aim for a soft announcement next Wed and publish the case study the week after.
Aisha: Customer success FYI — Helios wants a short technical call Thursday to review performance tuning tips (batching/quantization). Priya, can you lead?
Priya: Yep. I'll run the call and bring eng runtime folks (Elena + Minh).
Carlos: I'll prep the partner one-pager for Marketplace co-sell and loop in channel partners.
Elena: For the technical appendix, sample workload numbers: seq_len 512, avg tokens/sec 120k, KV cache hit ~28%. I'll drop a short code snippet in the case study.
Elena: ```yaml
redwood:
  deployment: dedicated
  autoscale:
    min: 4
    max: 16
  quantization: int8
``` 
Priya: Love it. Assigning tasks: Priya (case study + marketplace tile), Carlos (partner GTM), Elena (tech appendix + perf snippets), Ben (customer quote/legal follow-up), Aisha (announce coordination).
Ben: Congrats everyone — big win for the partnerships roadmap :rocket:
Aisha: Great work. Please add blockers here if anything slips. I'll post a follow-up with the approved quote and timeline.
